note: 100 playable Essencebound powers with working handlers; mod-original designs; experimental until in-game verified.

powers.name: Ember Bolt
powers.description: A focused flame strike. Can damage any targeted pawn, including allies.

powers.name: Frost Shard
powers.description: A chilling shard that deals damage and slows any targeted pawn.

powers.name: Storm Spark
powers.description: A crackling spell that deals damage and disrupts any targeted pawn.

powers.name: Verdant Mend
powers.description: Heal an injured pawn, whether ally or enemy.

powers.name: Guardian Ward
powers.description: Grant a temporary protective ward to any targeted pawn.

powers.name: Stone Skin
powers.description: Gain temporary armor with a small movement penalty.

powers.name: Swift Step
powers.description: Move faster for a short time.

powers.name: Mist Veil
powers.description: Gain short-lived evasive footwork; does not grant invisibility.

powers.name: Keen Sight
powers.description: Improve aiming and awareness for a short time.

powers.name: Rallying Surge
powers.description: Temporarily improve a targeted pawn's speed and work efficiency.

powers.name: Purifying Touch
powers.description: Remove an Essencebound chill or static affliction from any targeted pawn.

powers.name: Force Pulse
powers.description: Release a brief close-range pulse affecting nearby hostile pawns.

powers.name: Cinder Nova
powers.description: An expanding ring of burning essence damages hostile pawns around the caster.

powers.name: Thunder Chain
powers.description: Lightning leaps from the selected pawn to up to two nearby hostile pawns.

powers.name: Blood Siphon
powers.description: Deal damage to a chosen pawn and restore some of the caster's existing wounds from effective damage.

powers.name: Life Bloom
powers.description: Spread restorative essence across several wounds on a targeted pawn.

powers.name: Renewal Seed
powers.description: Plant a regeneration blessing that heals actual wounds every two seconds while active.

powers.name: Grove Shelter
powers.description: Create a protective aura around nearby nonhostile pawns that persists as independent wards.

powers.name: Purging Wave
powers.description: Clear Essencebound afflictions from nearby nonhostile pawns; no effect on healthy targets.

powers.name: Gravity Snare
powers.description: Bind a hostile pawn in slow-moving magical gravity; progress accrues while restrained.

powers.name: Corrosive Strike
powers.description: Damage a pawn and briefly reduce sharp and blunt armor with a corrosive affliction.

powers.name: Echo Burst
powers.description: Strike a selected pawn and damage nearby hostile pawns with a weaker concussive echo.

powers.name: Spirit Beacon
powers.description: Temporarily focus a pawn's accuracy and general work efficiency.

powers.name: Moonlit Reprieve
powers.description: Mend an injury and grant a modest protective blessing to the same pawn.

powers.name: Inferno Lance
powers.description: Focused long-range flame strikes a single pawn.

powers.name: Frost Halo
powers.description: A freezing impact ring strikes hostile pawns near the caster.

powers.name: Quakebreaker
powers.description: A targeted ground strike sends weaker tremors to visible nearby enemies.

powers.name: Zephyr Ricochet
powers.description: Air blades jump from one pawn to three visible nearby hostiles.

powers.name: Umbral Leech
powers.description: Drain vigor from a pawn and repair some of the caster's real injuries.

powers.name: Viper's Bite
powers.description: Damage a pawn and leave a slowing venom haze.

powers.name: Shard Volley
powers.description: Hardened crystal shards ricochet toward three visible nearby hostiles.

powers.name: Briar Detonation
powers.description: Explosive briars damage a selected pawn and entangle nearby visible hostiles.

powers.name: Starfall
powers.description: Celestial impact strikes a selected pawn and concusses nearby hostiles.

powers.name: Tidal Rebuke
powers.description: A short-range tidal shockwave affects hostile pawns near the caster.

powers.name: Iron Bastion
powers.description: Harden the caster's armor at the cost of some mobility.

powers.name: Mirror Guard
powers.description: Distort reflections around the caster for better dodge and light armor.

powers.name: Dawn Chorus
powers.description: Boost nearby nonhostile pawns with a shared movement and work focus.

powers.name: Verdant Sanctuary
powers.description: Restore real injuries on up to four nearby wounded allies.

powers.name: Ocean Renewal
powers.description: Apply gradual regeneration to up to four nearby wounded allies.

powers.name: Cleansing Ray
powers.description: Heal a selected pawn and remove temporary Essencebound afflictions.

powers.name: Mercy Thread
powers.description: Heal a chosen pawn and then two nearby wounded allies at lesser strength.

powers.name: Soul Harvest
powers.description: Drain nearby visible hostiles and restore some of the caster's injuries.

powers.name: Rune Bind
powers.description: Bind a hostile pawn's movement with a temporary controlling rune.

powers.name: Omen Hex
powers.description: Hex a hostile pawn to impair shooting accuracy and work speed.

powers.name: Temporal Haste
powers.description: Speed the caster's movement and work briefly.

powers.name: Battlefield Focus
powers.description: Improve ranged accuracy and evasive movement through combat focus.

powers.name: Blade Tempest
powers.description: Emit a close-range ring of cutting essence pressure against hostiles.

powers.name: Nemesis Strike
powers.description: Strike a pawn with greater force when it already has significant injuries.

powers.name: Thread Snare
powers.description: Strike a pawn with tangled essence that briefly slows its movement.

powers.name: Glass Ward
powers.description: Mend a pawn and surround it with protective crystalline armor.

powers.name: Ashen Comet
powers.description: Telegraph a falling fiery impact before it hits the map.

powers.name: Prismatic Deflection
powers.description: Reflect part of an incoming projectile toward its source.

powers.name: Lotus Sanctum
powers.description: Establish a sanctuary that heals wounded allies over time.

powers.name: Chrono Anchor
powers.description: Mark a safe tile and return there once before the mark expires.

powers.name: Wolfpack Call
powers.description: Summon spectral wolves with a limited lifetime.

powers.name: Spectral Hand
powers.description: Manipulate an eligible nearby object at a distance.

powers.name: Chimeric Aspect
powers.description: Adapt defense or offense to the most recent threat.

powers.name: Void Slip
powers.description: Blink to a reachable safe tile in line of sight.

powers.name: Fleshweave
powers.description: Spend temporary stamina to mend an allied injury.

powers.name: Tidal Wall
powers.description: Place a short-lived water obstruction along a chosen line.

powers.name: Lightning Step
powers.description: Reposition and release a shock at the landing point.

powers.name: Sovereign Command
powers.description: Order controlled allies or summons to focus on a target.

powers.name: Star Map
powers.description: Briefly reveal faraway terrain features and points of interest.

powers.name: Predator Mark
powers.description: Mark a foe to improve allied precision against that foe.

powers.name: Hydra Bloom
powers.description: Send regeneration pulses to multiple wounded pawns.

powers.name: Crystal Prison
powers.description: Surround a hostile pawn with temporary crystal obstacles.

powers.name: Echo Twin
powers.description: Create a short-lived echo decoy to distract hostiles.

powers.name: Resonance Field
powers.description: Strengthen essence damage for allies within a limited field.

powers.name: Guardian Bastion
powers.description: Create a dome that reduces incoming ranged attacks.

powers.name: Molten Rain
powers.description: Create a temporary burning hazard on selected ground.

powers.name: Oasis Well
powers.description: Create an out-of-combat restorative site for nearby allies.

powers.name: Bone Familiar
powers.description: Summon a small defensive magical construct companion.

powers.name: Mistwalk
powers.description: Temporarily make movement between cover harder to detect.

powers.name: Mirror Step
powers.description: Swap safe positions with a consenting allied pawn.

powers.name: Web Weaver
powers.description: Spread temporary webbing that slows hostile passage.

powers.name: Sonic Lance
powers.description: Release a focused sonic attack effective against light armor.

powers.name: Sunward Flare
powers.description: Remove darkness afflictions and emit a radiant burst.

powers.name: Moonshadow
powers.description: Gain additional evasion under dim light.

powers.name: Hunger Field
powers.description: Drain nearby hostile life while a channelled field lasts.

powers.name: Shatter Armor
powers.description: Reduce target armor durability based on a direct blow.

powers.name: Harvest Blessing
powers.description: Improve nearby plant harvest efficiency for a short time.

powers.name: Weave Ward
powers.description: Link two allies so protective boons share incoming harm.

powers.name: Rune Beacon
powers.description: Place a rune that grants defense to pawns within range.

powers.name: Iron Reprisal
powers.description: Retaliate against nearby hostile melee attacks for a duration.

powers.name: Serpent Coil
powers.description: Restrict enemy movement and offensive accuracy.

powers.name: Dawn Rebirth
powers.description: Trigger an emergency healing surge during a dangerous fight.

powers.name: Adept Convergence
powers.description: Temporarily redirect one attribute bonus into another.

powers.name: Fey Glamour
powers.description: Disrupt hostile targeting through illusory movement.

powers.name: Nimbus Guard
powers.description: Protect a moving pawn with a limited-duration storm shield.

powers.name: Blade Orbit
powers.description: Orbit enchanted blades that hit nearby hostiles periodically.

powers.name: Gravity Well
powers.description: Draw hostiles toward the center of a short-lived gravity field.

powers.name: Corrupting Seed
powers.description: Deal periodic damage while reducing target armor.

powers.name: Talisman Seal
powers.description: Store a defensive spell that triggers at the next threat.

powers.name: Pact of Unity
powers.description: Connect nearby allies for a temporary cooperative skill bonus.

powers.name: Phoenix Ashes
powers.description: Aid a severely injured pawn with a protective renewal boon.

powers.name: Worldstep
powers.description: Travel to a marked safe cell after a longer channel.

powers.name: Feral Claw
powers.description: Reward successive close attacks with a stacking offensive bonus.

powers.name: Ward Echo
powers.description: Return a portion of enemy control effects back to their caster.

powers.name: Sands of Stillness
powers.description: Create a temporary zone that slows hostile movement.

powers.name: Tempest Flock
powers.description: Conjure a flock of distracting magical birds.

taxonomy.description: Primary category identifies the main use; tags can include multiple categories and mechanics. Primary essence is the first favored essence, not a learning restriction.
taxonomy.gameplay_affinity_rule: Existing compatibleAspects and favoredEssences remain unchanged; taxonomy is presentation metadata only.
